parameters.name: SignatureKey
parameters.description: The Key value of the key. The value must be 6 to 20 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter.

parameters.name: SignatureName
parameters.description: The displayed name of the key. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter.

parameters.name: SignatureSecret
parameters.description: The Secret value of the key. The value must be 6 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include underscores (\_), at signs (@), number signs (#), exclamation points (!), and asterisks (\*). The value must start with a letter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-signature --signature-name backendsignature --signature-key qwertyuiop --signature-secret asdfghjkl --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi CreateSignature --region cn-hangzhou --SignatureSecret asdfghjkl --SignatureName backendsignature --SignatureKey qwertyuiop
